import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

# ---- several route keys -> one origin, offsets accumulate in FIN order
R = {'https://demo.test': 'same', 'https://alt.test': 'same', 'http://x.test': 'other'}
ev = (stream(0, base_fields(path='/one', authority='demo.test'))
      + stream(4, base_fields(path='/two', authority='alt.test'))
      + stream(8, base_fields(path='/three', authority='alt.test'))
      + stream(12, base_fields(path='/four', authority='demo.test', scheme='http')))
got = run({'routes': R, 'events': ev})
w1 = b'GET /one HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'
w2 = b'GET /two HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: alt.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'
w3 = b'GET /three HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: alt.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'
w4 = b'GET /four HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'
check('shared-origin', {'routes': R, 'events': ev},
      [rec(0,'forwarded',commit_at=1,origin='same',offset=0,length=len(w1),cache_key=['GET','https','demo.test','/one']),
       rec(4,'forwarded',commit_at=3,origin='same',offset=len(w1),length=len(w2),cache_key=['GET','https','alt.test','/two']),
       rec(8,'forwarded',commit_at=5,origin='same',offset=len(w1)+len(w2),length=len(w3),cache_key=['GET','https','alt.test','/three']),
       rec(12,'forwarded',commit_at=7,origin='other',offset=0,length=len(w4),cache_key=['GET','http','demo.test','/four'])],
      {'same': w1+w2+w3, 'other': w4},
      extra=lambda g: parse_pipeline(bytes.fromhex(g['origins']['same'])))

# ---- interleaved streams, RESET overrides earlier validity
R2 = {'https://demo.test': 'r1'}
ev = ([{'sid':0,'type':'headers','fields':base_fields(path='/a')},
       {'sid':4,'type':'headers','fields':base_fields(path='/b')},
       {'sid':0,'type':'data','hex':'6162'},
       {'sid':4,'type':'data','hex':'6364'},
       {'sid':8,'type':'data','hex':'65'},
       {'sid':8,'type':'headers','fields':base_fields(path='/c', extra=[('content-length','1')])},
       {'sid':0,'type':'fin'},
       {'sid':4,'type':'reset'},
       {'sid':8,'type':'fin'}])
wb = b'GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 2\r\n\r\nab'
wc = b'GET /c HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 1\r\n\r\ne'
check('interleaved', {'routes': R2, 'events': ev},
      [rec(0,'forwarded',commit_at=6,origin='r1',offset=0,length=len(wb),cache_key=['GET','https','demo.test','/a']),
       rec(4,'cancelled'),
       rec(8,'forwarded',commit_at=8,origin='r1',offset=len(wb),length=len(wc),cache_key=['GET','https','demo.test','/c'])],
      {'r1': wb + wc})

# ---- bad initial headers then reset -> cancelled (reset wins)
ev = ([{'sid':0,'type':'headers','fields':base_fields(extra=[('connection','close')])},
       {'sid':0,'type':'reset'}])
check('reset-after-bad', {'routes': R2, 'events': ev}, [rec(0,'cancelled')], {'r1': b''})

# ---- latin-1 octets preserved in values, names and body
f = base_fields(method='POST', path='/p', extra=[('x-lat', 'caf\xe9'), ('x-audit-ish','\x80\xff')])
ev = stream(0, f, data=['00e9ff'], trailing=[['x-audit-l', '\xe9']])
got = run({'routes': R2, 'events': ev})
want = (b'POST /p HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\nx-lat: caf\xe9\r\nx-audit-ish: \x80\xff\r\n'
        b'transfer-encoding: chunked\r\ntrailer: x-audit-l\r\n\r\n'
        b'3\r\n\x00\xe9\xff\r\n0\r\nx-audit-l: \xe9\r\n\r\n')
check('latin1', {'routes': R2, 'events': ev}, None, {'r1': want})
assert json.dumps(got).isascii(), 'output must stay ASCII-safe'

# ---- non-latin1 field string is not decodable -> rejected, no crash
ev = [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'headers',
       'fields': base_fields() + [['x-bad', 'caf\xc3\xa9'.encode().decode('utf-8')]]},
      {'sid': 0, 'type': 'fin'}]
out = run({'routes': R2, 'events': ev})
assert out['streams'][0]['status'] == 'rejected', out['streams']
print('ok   non-latin1 field rejected')

# ---- many streams, one origin, offset/length bookkeeping, independent parse
R3 = {'https://demo.test': 'r1', 'https://alt.test': 'r1'}
events = []
for i in range(60):
    sid = i * 4
    events += stream(sid, base_fields(path='/p%d' % i, authority='demo.test' if i % 2 else 'alt.test'),
                     data=[('%02x' % (i & 0xff)) * (i % 5)] if i % 3 == 0 else None,
                     trailing=[['x-audit-n', str(i)]] if i % 4 == 0 else None)
    if i % 7 == 3:
        events = events[:-1] + [{'sid': sid, 'type': 'reset'}]
    if i % 11 == 5:
        events = events[:-1]  # leave incomplete
got = run({'routes': R3, 'events': events})
sids = [s['sid'] for s in got['streams']]
assert sids == sorted(sids) == list(range(0, 240, 4))
statuses = {}
for s in got['streams']:
    statuses.setdefault(s['status'], 0)
    statuses[s['status']] += 1
    if s['status'] == 'forwarded':
        pipe = bytes.fromhex(got['origins']['r1'])
        assert pipe[s['offset']:s['offset'] + s['length']], (s['offset'], s['length'])
recs = parse_pipeline(bytes.fromhex(got['origins']['r1']))
assert sum(r['length'] for r in recs) == len(bytes.fromhex(got['origins']['r1']))
offs = [r['offset'] for r in recs]
assert offs == sorted(offs) and offs[0] == 0
for a, b in zip(recs, recs[1:]):
    assert a['offset'] + a['length'] == b['offset']
fwd = [s for s in got['streams'] if s['status'] == 'forwarded']
assert len(fwd) == len(recs), (len(fwd), len(recs))
seen = sorted((s['offset'], s['length']) for s in fwd)
assert seen == [(r['offset'], r['length']) for r in recs]
print('ok   60-stream bookkeeping', statuses)

# ---- 256 streams / 4096 events performance probe
import time
events = []
for i in range(1000):
    sid = (i % 256) * 4
    events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'headers',
                   'fields': base_fields(method='POST', path='/p%d' % i,
                                         extra=[('x-k%d' % (i % 40), 'v%d' % i)])})
    events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'data', 'hex': ('ab' * 20)})
    events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'fin'})
t0 = time.time()
got = run({'routes': R3, 'events': events})
dt = time.time() - t0
assert len(got['streams']) == 256
total = sum(len(v) for v in bytes.fromhex(got['origins']['r1']) and [bytes.fromhex(got['origins']['r1'])])
recs = parse_pipeline(bytes.fromhex(got['origins']['r1']))
assert len(recs) == 256, len(recs)
assert all(r['length'] > 0 for r in recs)
print('ok   3000-event stress in %.2fs' % dt)
assert dt < 10, dt

summary()
